title: Environment, Effects, Scene State & Audiovisual Orchestration
objective: Compose already-authorized Scene/World/Event/Combat/Weather/Travel/Vehicle/Magic state with MAI visual-layer references and AAI cue/soundscape references into deterministic environment/effect presentation intents and governed audiovisual transitions, preserving Manual, Suggest and explicitly authorized Automatic modes, GM override, silence/no-effects, canonical owner state and completed ISE-01..05 authority boundaries.
preserved_boundaries: Authorization-before-projection filtered hidden/GM-only environment state, effect metadata, MAI visual references, AAI cue metadata, orchestration bindings/signals and protected cardinality before ISE-06 input.
Scene/World/Event/Combat/Weather/Travel/Vehicle/Magic state and MAI/AAI ownership remained canonical; ISE-06 created no parallel gameplay, environment, media or automation ledger.

Manual remained local presentation only; Suggest required an existing owner-operation proposal; authorized Automatic required explicit authorization and emitted provider-neutral presentation actions only.
Expected owner version, deterministic idempotency, permission decisions, consent, GM override/adjudication and Action/Event or owner-domain validation remained mandatory.
No provider calls, credentials, entitlement inference, commercial-media redistribution, gameplay truth or canonical mutation was implemented.
Silence, no-effects, missing visual/audio assets and mapless theater-of-the-mind remained valid nonblocking states.
Migration 0022 was not reserved and ISE-07+ feature authority was not implemented.
Paid provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment were not authorized.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: The first owner execution turn merged application PR #345 to 1e957436bdc479d2a292866ea5032962ee0ba2bc but AIOC closeout did not merge because the convergence-scorecard write used a stale blob SHA and returned HTTP 409. Canonical AIOC main therefore still projected ISE-06 in_progress after the application merge until this second owner Continue resumed the staged closeout branch.
diagnostic_hypotheses: Governed-start failures were repository_state drift caused by shortening still-sealed MV-CONT-007 maintenance projections on two live AIOC surfaces; restoring those exact sealed identities reconciled the control plane.

The first application failure was validation_contract only: Markdown emphasis made authored prose invisible to literal verifier markers; normalizing Markdown in the verifier would advance validation without product behavior changes.

The second application failure was feature_implementation at the composition seam: ISE-06 reused an inherited callback name with an incompatible narrower type; preserving one callback that accepts both predecessor and current proposal types would keep composition intact and satisfy type safety.

The post-merge closeout interruption was repository_state/tool concurrency rather than product failure: refreshing the scorecard blob SHA and finishing the already-staged closeout should reconcile AIOC main without reopening application implementation or changing ISE-07 authority.

retry_basis.evidence: The interrupted closeout returned HTTP 409 because EXECUTION_CONVERGENCE_SCORECARD.json no longer matched the stale blob SHA supplied to update_file. This second owner Continue refreshed the branch scorecard to blob 62844d30bf26b65b2265d623d4461942ebe24029 and found the closeout branch still exactly nine commits ahead of AIOC main with the other nine closeout surfaces intact.
changed_since_previous: Refreshed the exact scorecard blob identity instead of repeating the failed stale-SHA write.
Corrected live convergence accounting to two owner Continues and two execution cycles, with one post-merge stale-pointer incident and same_cycle_completed=false.

Kept ISE-06 product evidence, application merge, ISE-07 selection-only state, stable validation seals, provider restrictions and migration posture unchanged while completing the interrupted AIOC closeout transaction.

next_action: ISE-06 is completed_verified and its implementation authority is retired. ISE-07 is selected_not_started only; a future owner Continue is required before governed start or product mutation.
